name: Hierarchical Keywording
description: Lightroom-class hierarchical keywords for your library. Organize keywords in a tree with synonyms and per-keyword export flags, apply them with autocomplete, checkboxes, or drag-and-drop, and filter the grid by any branch (children included). Exchange complete keyword lists with Lightroom via .txt import/export, and let existing hierarchies build themselves from XMP sidecars on import.
author: Anthony Reimche <anthonyreimche@gmail.com>
